name: Prefiltered Reconstruction
definition: A reconstruction technique where input samples are first convolved with a discrete prefilter to yield coefficients, which are then convolved with a continuous postfilter. This allows non-interpolating filters (like cubic B-splines) to act as interpolators and improves approximation order.
summary: Prefiltered Reconstruction improves cubic B-spline volume rendering by convolving samples with a discrete prefilter to correct oversmoothing and achieve interpolating accuracy.
